title: New Site Setup
description: Standard configuration steps for every new client WordPress site

steps.title: Set site title and tagline
steps.instructions: Update to the client's official business name. Do not use the dev/staging placeholder.

steps.title: Set admin email address
steps.instructions: Change from developer email to client's primary contact. Confirm they can receive emails to this address.

steps.title: Configure permalink structure
steps.instructions: Set to Post name unless client has specific requirements. Save twice — first save generates .htaccess.

steps.title: Set timezone and date format
steps.instructions: Set to client's local timezone, not UTC. Critical for scheduled posts and WooCommerce orders.

steps.title: Disable search engine indexing on staging
steps.instructions: Check Settings > Reading. Staging: indexing OFF. Live: indexing ON. Verify before handoff.

steps.title: Delete default content
steps.instructions: Remove Hello World post, Sample Page, and any default plugins (Hello Dolly). Leave Akismet if needed.

steps.title: Set default user role
steps.instructions: Change default user role from Subscriber to appropriate role for this site.

steps.title: Configure comment settings
steps.instructions: Disable comments if not needed. Enable moderation queue if comments are on.
